main_text.p: דלט דילטור Ch. Delator, accusator, detractor. Videtur esse vox Latina.
* דלל Attenuari, Hebr. Hinc דל Tenuis, attenuatus. Unde plural. fœmin. constr. דלת עמא Tenues populi, Cant.7.5.
ܝܣܕܠܢ Syr. Repudium, ܝܝܣܕܠܢ ܟܠܦܢ Libellus repudii, Matth.5.31.
דלף Chald. Stillare, distillare, perstillare. Partic. דדלף Quod stillat, Prov.19.13.

דלק Ch.& Syr. Ardere, flagrare, accendi, succendi: Fervidè, Ardenter persequi & infestari aliquem. Aphel אדליק Accendere, incendere, succendere, comburere. Ex Ithpehal אתדלקא ברניתהא Incensa sunt palatia ejus, Jerem.51.30.
הדליקא Ch. Idem, Esth.3.8. in Targ.sec.
דם דמא & cum prothesi ארמא, ארם, ארם, א Ch.& Syr. Sanguis, reatus sanguinis. Plural. דמין Pecuniæ, pretium; Syr. ܕܡܝܢ 1.ad Cor.6.20. Act.5.3.4. Sic idé est quod טימי, Syr. ܛܝܡܐ, quod vide suo loco.
ܦܣ Syr. Ne forte, μήπως, Heb. פן, ad Gal.2.2.

page.notes: Several lines are Syriac and Hebrew/Chaldee script; Hebrew and Syriac letters are transcribed approximately, with uncertain vowel points and some Syriac forms. Printed letters in the Hebrew lines at "Lucæ 18.25" and "Plur." Syriac forms are only approximated.
